Class DutyCycle

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.hardware.rotation.DutyCycle
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Sendable
public class DutyCycle extends Object implements Sendable, AutoCloseable
Class to read a duty cycle PWM input.

PWM input signals are specified with a frequency and a ratio of high to low in that frequency. These can be attached to any SmartIO.
